minutes.headline: Parks Commission backed a fall youth soccer pickup program and set a vote on higher field-use fees for next meeting.
minutes.summary: The three-member commission approved the August 3 minutes and adopted three goals for the 2020-21 season. It discussed a proposed pickup soccer program, a proposed field-use fee increase (vote deferred so Little League can comment), Marshall Park master planning, and the commission's needs in the TC Passios building. The charter change to a five-member board, which raises the quorum to three, was reported.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the August 3, 2020 meeting
Adopt three goals (policy documents, public engagement, Marshall Park) as the commission's goals for the 2020-21 season

budget_items.topic: Program vendor fees and revolving fund
budget_items.what_was_said: The recreation director adds a percentage to the vendor's per-person fee; the addition goes to the revolving fund to offset credit card fees and fund future free events.
Current per-player fee for Little League was noted, with proposed increases for resident, non-resident and adult users and for camps and clinics. The vote was deferred to the next meeting.
figures_as_heard: twenty five and thirty five dollars

budget_items.topic: Where field fees go: parks line and revolving fund
budget_items.what_was_said: Maintenance bills are paid from the parks line item under DPW, while program fees go to the revolving account, which can be used for programming or improvements. Funds have been returned to free cash in recent years.
The fees would start in January if Little League has not yet planned spring registration, otherwise July.
A member asked about pricing at an outside turf field and indoor facility for the pickup season.

budget_items.topic: Possible outside funding for Marshall Park consultant
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said funding could be sought through legislation, earmarks or a bond to hire a consultant.
The design process will produce a real cost number for renovating the building; the roof would be replaced if the project goes forward.
The schools charge for indoor space, which affects winter programming costs.

decisions.decision: The commission supported the pickup soccer idea and left Chris and the recreation director to work out details and field requests.
Field-use fee discussion held tonight; the vote will be on the agenda at the next meeting so user groups can comment.
Each commissioner will email ideas for Marshall Park to the recreation director, who will organize them for a later meeting.
The recreation director will ask DPW to do overdue maintenance such as the basketball court, invasives and track.
Field use policy to be put on a future agenda as field usage fees and policies for approval.
Parks will tell the TC Passios building committee it could use flex space, without requesting dedicated square footage.
Next meeting date will not be set until the high school soccer schedule is out; a Marshall Park walk and skate park discussion are to be planned.

what_happened.line: The Parks Commission adopted three goals for the 2020-21 season: policy documents, public engagement and Marshall Park.
The commission supported a fall pickup soccer program and left details and field requests to a member and the recreation director.
Discussion of higher field-use fees was held, and the vote was put on the next agenda so user groups such as Little League can comment.
Commissioners will email Marshall Park ideas to the recreation director, who will also ask DPW about overdue maintenance.
Parks will tell the TC Passios building committee it could use flex space, without asking for dedicated square footage.

why_it_matters: Field-use fees for residents, non-residents, adults, camps and clinics may rise, and the fee would reach youth leagues and other groups that use town fields.
Where fee money goes matters: maintenance is paid from the parks line under DPW, while program fees go to a revolving fund that can fund programming or improvements.
The TC Passios renovation has no real cost yet; the design process will produce one, and the roof would be replaced if the project goes forward.
watch_next: The field-use fee vote on the next meeting's agenda, with the date to be set after the high school soccer schedule is out.
A Marshall Park walk and a skate park discussion, both still to be planned.
